cards.title: Stilt boss, try two
cards.text: A carved jungle idol head on six bamboo stilts, up near the Witch's broom height or above. 0.34.0. Old Longlegs stays.
cards.why: You wanted something on stilts, the head very high, much larger, jungle, leggy but not a spider. Try it in battle mode's 'No dungeon yet' tab or the Book. Mark any part that's off.

parts.title: The idol
parts.text: A hardwood head: heavy brow, glowing eyes, toothed jaw with tusks, jade ear spools, moss and red blooms on its back, a crown of leaves with seed pods. Each stilt is ringed bamboo, lashed at the knee, on a carved stone hoof.

parts.title: Height and size
parts.text: The head rides almost twice the broom's height (132 against 70; Old Longlegs 44), drawn bigger for being nearer, one shadow far below. Its feet stand in a ring 360 across (the spider's 252). It stays clear of the walls.

parts.title: Stomp
parts.text: A stilt swings up nearly straight, hangs, and stabs down into a red circle.

parts.title: Head slam
parts.text: Eyes go orange, a circle follows its shadow, a short pause, then it drops the whole height. On a miss it lies stunned (longer per broken stilt) and takes extra damage.

parts.title: Liana (new)
parts.text: A vine drops on the furthest hero; caught, they're hauled in under the head and tangled for a moment.

parts.title: Seed pods (new)
parts.text: The crown shakes and three pods fall the whole height onto circles (four later). The first of each shower grows a Sproutling.

parts.title: Broken stilts
parts.text: As the spider: each hoof has its own health; broken, the stilt snaps to a swinging stump and drags. It slows with each. The fourth break drops it to the floor, where it fights on.

parts.title: Strength
parts.text: 1550 health. Across four parties it wins about as often as Old Longlegs (118 against 128 of 160, within the noise).

cards.title: Stilts under the face
cards.text: Every stilt is drawn under the head, even the near knees, so the face is never covered.
cards.why: Strictly the near knees would cross in front of the face. Drawing them under keeps the idol's face readable all fight; it only looks off if you stare at the knees.

cards.title: Heroes under the head
cards.text: A hero hidden under the head shows as a pale dashed ring on top of it.
cards.why: The head is so big it hides whoever's under it. Fading the head instead would mean drawing it on its own layer, a bigger job.
